releaseNotes:
What's New in Version 2.9.1 🚀
- Real-Time Total Focus Updates: Total focus time now updates simultaneously every minute and on user actions across all insights without needing to end the session.
- Subject Heatmap Planner Sync: Subject-wise heatmaps now automatically sync and scale to your Planner subject goals (defaulting to 1h 30m if no goal is set).
- Subject Time Deduction & Logging Fixes: Enhanced subject time addition, deduction, and block deletions with 100% data consistency across timeline logs and daily stats.
